chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Ali ibn al-Hakam from Abu al-Faraj who said:

Aban asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), 'Was there a Tawaf of the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) by which he was recognized?' So he (peace be upon him) said: 'The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) used to perform Tawaf by night and by day, ten circuits: three at the beginning of the night, and three at the end of the night, and two when it was morning, and two after midday; and whatever was in between that was his rest.'

key_terms.أَسَابِيعَ: Circuits (plural of sabi'ah, a specific measure of circuits in Tawaf)

ai.seo_question: What was the Prophet's specific routine for performing Tawaf during the day and night?
ai.summary: This hadith from *Al-Kafi* highlights the Prophet Muhammad’s (peace be upon him and his family) voluntary devotion by performing ten circuits of Tawaf daily, divided into four distinct sessions to balance worship with rest. This practice underscores the Shia emphasis on *Sunnah* as a model for consistent, structured piety, illustrating that ritual acts can be integrated into daily life without neglecting physical well-being. It serves as a practical guide for believers seeking to emulate the Prophet’s spiritual discipline through regular, manageable acts of circumambulation.
